title: Notification regarding date of Written Examination for recruitment to the 11(Eleven) vacant posts of System Assistant in the High Court of Manipur.
text:
KEY LINES:
THOKCHOM FEEMI DEVI

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the IF November, 2026
No. HCM/A-96/2023/Estt./£qoqs : in pursuance of this Registry's
Advertisement of even number dated 3'd November, 2025 for recruitment to the 11
(eleven) vacant posts of System Assistant in the High Court of Manipur, all concerned
are hereby informed that the Written Examination shall be held on 27th December,
2026 (Sunday) at Imphal and Guwahati Centres.
Further, taking into consideration the preferences exercised by the candidates in
response to this Registry’s Notifications of even number dated 26th December, 2025 and
3rd February, 2026, the list of 1,087 (one thousand and eighty-seven) candidates, along
with their respective Examination Centres, is annexed herewith as Annexure. The
candidates shall appear in the Written Examination at their respective Examination
Centres on the date scheduled above.
The detailed schedule of the Written Examination shall be indicated in the
respective Admit Cards. A separate notification in this regard shall be issued in due
course. The Admit Cards and subsequent notifications shall be made available
exclusively on the official website of the High Court of Manipur, www.hcmimphal.nic.in.
Candidates are advised to regularly visit the official website of the High Court of
Manipur for further updates-in this regard,- -–– – - - –– –- -
(OJESH MUTUM)
REGISTRAR GENERAL
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Copy to:-
1. The Principal Secretary to Hon’ble The Chief Justice, High Court of Manipur.
2. The Private Secretary to Hon'ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh, High Court of Manipur.
3. The Private Secretary to Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma, High Court of
Manipur.
Z The System Analyst, High Court of Manipur.
- He is requested to upload the same in the Official Website of this Registry.
5. Notice Board/Concerned File.
